assessments.reasoning: The title and copyright pages identify Goldberg and Robson’s Smalltalk-80 volume, Addison-Wesley, Xerox copyright 1983 and ISBN 0-201-11371-6. Printed Preface p. vi expressly identifies a Smalltalk-80 programming language and separates its syntax in Part One from system functionality in Part Two and virtual-machine specification in Part Four.

challenge.method: Test whether the same label is a system-only name by reading the cataloging page, the first Part One description and the entire four-part preface. Compare Kay’s release version terminology.
challenge.results: The catalog describes a computer system, and the preface also identifies the Smalltalk-80 programming language in its own right. The edition entity concerns that language scope, with product, language and VM uses of the label distinguished.

limitations: The record identifies the language edition described in the Blue Book, ISBN 0-201-11371-6.
Smalltalk-80 also names the surrounding system in this publication. The registry entity denotes the programming language edition.
The exact edition and claim locator were reviewed from the registered publication.
